# dayloop v0.12.0-rc4 — P5R command UI review build

This prerelease is an installable candidate for checking the refined P5R task commands, navigation, typography, and completion behavior on a real device.

## What changed since rc3

- Rebuilt Tasks, Check all, End day, and Undo day around the same compact P5R command-plate geometry and thick date display face.
- Made Tasks and End day black-on-red; Check all and Undo day use red type on black with a white keyline and offset.
- Expanded and centered End day inside its pinned half-width footer action.
- Changed the deadline title to red without altering the days-left urgency color.
- Removed Deadlines from the bottom navigation while keeping deadline results reachable from Search.
- Changed P5R Confidant names in the Confidants list to thick red display type; rank, route, and date metadata are unchanged.
- Changed Calendar's Achievements this month heading to thick black display type.
- Set both Day Complete and Perfect Day holds to exactly three seconds; Perfect Day copy is red.
- Removed the Later task action. Existing saved Later marks remain readable for backward compatibility.
- End day now records every unchecked task on the departing day as Skipped before advancing the clock.

## What to check

- Compare Tasks and Check all: their plates should be similarly compact and their text should use the same thick face as dates.
- Confirm End day and Undo day remain pinned, fill their halves of the footer, and center their enlarged labels.
- Mark a task Done and confirm its text is struck through; task rows should expose only Done and Skip controls.
- Leave tasks unchecked, tap End day, then undo the day and confirm those previously unchecked tasks are marked Skipped.
- Confirm both completion treatments remain visible for about three seconds and can still be dismissed early.
- Confirm the bottom bar no longer contains Deadlines, while a deadline Search result can still open the deadline list.
- Inspect the Confidants list and Calendar's monthly achievement heading for the revised type and colors.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Its profiles, progress, and settings are separate from the stable app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc4` (`versionCode 17`).

_Fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by ATLUS/SEGA._
